story.titleZh: 美国大奖赛后维斯塔潘与哈贾尔对红牛表达不满
story.summaryZh: 美国大奖赛后，维斯塔潘和哈贾尔因起步不佳、无线电通讯问题以及两停策略选择对红牛表达强烈不满，维斯塔潘认为两停策略让一停的安东内利拿下胜利。
story.originalTitle: Why US GP has left Verstappen and Hadjar furious at Red Bull
story.summaryEn: After the United States Grand Prix, Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar voiced strong frustration with Red Bull over poor starts, radio communication problems and the two-stop strategy call, with Verstappen believing it opened the door for one-stopping Kimi Antonelli to win.
detailZh: 美国大奖赛后，马克斯·维斯塔潘和伊萨克·哈贾尔因一系列本可避免的问题对红牛表达强烈不满，这些问题让他们无法充分发挥赛车的潜力。
起步阶段就出了问题，维斯塔潘和哈贾尔分别从第二位和第三位发车，但起步表现不佳。
随后两人在整场比赛中都受到无线电问题的困扰，与维修区墙的沟通变得困难；同时维斯塔潘对两停策略的选择感到恼火，这一选择让一停的基米·安东内利得以拿下统治性胜利。
尽管车队领队洛朗·梅基斯在冲线后立即通过无线电承认车队有"几件事需要整理"，但驾驶舱内的沮丧情绪显然十分强烈。
在拿下第三名冲过终点线后，维斯塔潘在赛后一段语气低沉的无线电信息中说：“太糟糕了：速度、错误的轮胎、糟糕的进站、糟糕的发动机制动。什么都不管用。”
赛后接受Viaplay采访时，被问及是否同意在第二段 stint 中改用软胎、而当时看起来更应该使用更硬配方轮胎的策略决定，维斯塔潘说：“不，并没有达成一致。这就是我不理解的原因。那样的话，所有人都会知道我们要执行两停。”
随后，在提到平衡和发动机制动方面的挣扎——而持续的无线电问题让情况雪上加霜——维斯塔潘讽刺地对媒体说：“也许我们干脆开始用手语交流算了。那样可能还更便宜。”
“这是一场灾难。说实话，真的非常令人沮丧。”
哈贾尔更加愤怒，他暗示红牛需要重新设计离合器，因为起步多次乏力。
“需要重新设计，因为目前它太脆弱了，”最终以第六名完赛的哈贾尔说道。“它无法很好地应对温度。这真的很艰难。”
随后，他对车队无线电这样相对简单的事情为何会成为如此令人沮丧的问题表示困惑。
“目前我们连小事都做不好，”他说。“我的无线电很差，我甚至不知道发生了什么。我松开离合器，结果就变成了一场噩梦。
“我们把这两个问题解决掉，可能就能登上领奖台了。看起来最难的事情我们能做到，而那些愚蠢的小事却做不到。”
梅基斯很清楚这些问题，它们让原本可能的胜利挑战变成了车手们一个令人沮丧的下午。
关于维斯塔潘的策略决定，红牛表示需要分析为什么第二段 stint（ stint）的轮胎退化如此严重，考虑到比赛开局阶段与安东内利的对抗看起来相当势均力敌。
被问及维斯塔潘的抱怨时，梅基斯说：“我不确定他指的是什么，因为我没有听到他说的话，但我觉得可能让他感到意外的一件事是，我们选择给他装上第二套软胎，这当然不是我们的基准选项。”
“不幸的是，正如你在第二阶段看到的那样，我们也遭遇了相当高的轮胎磨损，所以这可能是我们需要一起复盘的事情之一，为什么我们在第二阶段磨损得那么厉害。”
不过，梅基斯认为，无论选择什么策略，安东内利的速度优势都意味着他无论如何都会赢——而红牛传统上在较软配方上表现更好。
“可以说，与竞争对手相比，我们通常在较软配方上享有一点优势，但今天我们很难利用这一优势，”他说。
“我们为马克斯使用了两套较软配方，磨损相当高，这当然无助于我们落实第二次进站。”
维斯塔潘确实认为，红牛被拖入了一个基于其赛车在最近几场比赛中使用软胎表现良好而做出的决定。
他说：“有一刻很明显，使用更硬配方轮胎的人找到了很多抓地力，所以我想我们也没有真正对此做出反应。”
“可能只是过于坚持我们过去两场比赛的信念，当时更软的配方是最快的，而显然在这里那没有奏效。”
关于无线电问题，梅基斯表示，红牛对于为何连续第二场比赛遭遇这个问题感到困惑，但表示现在修复它是优先事项。
他说：“如果我们真的弄明白了，那问题早就解决了。所以我们并不完全清楚为什么会受到这些问题的影响。”
“当然，我必须承认竞争对手比我们做得更好，因为我们显然能听到所有人的无线电，而我们一直挣扎得比我们希望的要更多。”
他补充道：“这让每个人的日子都非常难过，所以这确实是我们希望尽快解决的问题，因为这是一个本应正常工作、不应耗费我们太多精力的事项。”
关于起步不佳以及哈贾尔提出需要重新设计离合器的建议，梅基斯认为这更像是2027年的项目，而非短期内的任务。
起步依赖于包括发动机、变速箱和离合器在内的多种元素的组合，因此这不是能够快速解决的问题。
因此，尽管可以继续改进以尽量减少问题，但在明年年初之前不太可能有更大的修复。
梅基斯补充道：“尽管我们已经缩小了与竞争对手的差距，你可能还记得我们年初的起步有多糟糕，但我们仍然不是标杆。”
“事实上，赛车在此期间有了很大改进，并且更接近前排竞争，这使得现在的这一劣势更加痛苦，因为我们周围的竞争非常激烈。
"一方面，我有信心从现在到年底我们会继续缩小与竞争对手的差距，因为每一场比赛我们都在学习，每一场比赛我们都能找到缩小差距的小方法。
"另一方面，我同样清楚，在赛季结束前我们不会成为标杆，这需要一些重大的设计和硬件改动，而这是我们只有到明年才会看到的事情。"
detailEn: Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar let rip at Red Bull after Formula 1's United States Grand Prix for a series of avoidable problems that left them unable to fully capitalise on the potential of their car.
Things went wrong at the start as Verstappen and Hadjar in particular made poor getaways from second and third on the grid.

The pair were then hampered throughout the race by radio problems that made communication with the pitwall difficult, while Verstappen was annoyed about the choice of a two-stop strategy that left the door open for the one-stopping Kimi Antonelli to take a dominant win.

Despite a radio message from team principal Laurent Mekies immediately after the chequered flag confessing the team had "a few things to tidy up", it was clear that frustrations were high in the cockpit.
In a bleak post-race radio message after taking the chequered flag in third, Verstappen said: "Terrible: the pace, the wrong tyre, sh** pitstop, sh** engine braking. Nothing worked."

Speaking to Viaplay after the race about whether he agreed on the strategy call in committing to softs for the second stint when the harder compounds appeared to be in play, Verstappen said: "No, it wasn't agreed upon. That's why I don't get it. Then everyone would know we're doing a two-stop."

Later on, referencing struggles with balance and engine braking that were not helped by the ongoing radio problems, Verstappen sarcastically told the media: "Maybe we just start communicating in sign language. It's probably cheaper as well.
"It's a disaster. It's really frustrating, to be honest."
Hadjar was even angrier, as he suggested that Red Bull needed a new clutch design because of the repeated weak starts.
"It needs a redesign because at the moment it's too fragile," said Hadjar, who eventually came home sixth. "It's not coping well with temperatures. It's a real struggle."
And then he expressed bafflement about why a relatively simple thing such as the team radio was such a frustrating issue.
"At the moment it's the little things we can't do," he said. "I have a poor radio, I don't even know what's happening. I dropped the clutch, it's going into a nightmare.
"We fix these two already, we might be on the podium. The hardest things it seems like we can do, and the silly things we can't."
Mekies was well aware of the issues that turned a possible victory challenge into a frustrating afternoon for his drivers.

On Verstappen's strategy call, Red Bull said it needed to analyse why the degradation on that second stint had been so poor, considering that the opening part of the race against Antonelli had appeared to be quite evenly matched.

Asked about Verstappen's complaints, Mekies said: "I'm not sure what he was referring to, because I didn't hear what he said, but I think one thing that may have surprised him is the fact that we elected to put him in the second set on softs, [it] was certainly not the baseline option for us.

"Unfortunately, as you have seen in that second stint, we also suffered a fairly high degradation, so it was probably one of the things we will review together, on why we degraded that much in that second stint."
Mekies felt, however, that whatever strategy was chosen Antonelli’s pace advantage meant he would have won anyway - and Red Bull has traditionally gone better on the softer compounds.
"It's probably fair to say that we normally enjoy a bit of an advantage compared to competition with the softer compounds, and today we have struggled to use that advantage," he said.
"We have suffered some fairly high deg with Max on the two sets of softer compounds that we had, and that certainly didn't help materialising the second stop."
Verstappen certainly thought Red Bull had got sucked into a call based on how well its car had run on softs in recent races.
"At one point it was quite clear that the people on the harder compounds were finding a lot of grip, so I guess we also didn't really react to that," he said.
"Just probably sticking too much to our belief from the last two races, where the softer compounds were the fastest, and clearly here that didn't work."
On the radio issue, Mekies said that Red Bull was confused about why it had been hit with this problem for the second race running, but said it was now a priority to fix.
"If we were understanding it, we would have solved it," he said. "So we don't fully understand why we are being hit by these issues.
"Certainly, I have to admit that the competition is doing a better job than us, because we can obviously hear everyone's radio, and we have been struggling more than what we would have liked to."

He added: "It's making everyone's lives very difficult, so it is true that it's something that we would like to fix quite quickly, because it's an item that should be working without using too much of our energy."
In terms of the poor starts and Hadjar's suggestion of the need for a clutch redesign, Mekies thought this was more a project for 2027 than the short term.
With starts reliant on a combination of elements - including engine, gearbox and clutch - it is not something that can be quickly addressed.
So while improvements could continue to be made to minimise the problems, a bigger fix is unlikely before the start of next year.
Mekies added: "As much as we have reduced the gap to competition, and you may remember how bad our starts were at the beginning of the year, we are still not the benchmark.
"The fact that the car in the meantime improved a lot, and is fighting closer to the front, makes that deficit even more painful now, because competition around us is very strong.

"On one side I'm confident that we will continue to reduce the gap to the competition from now to the end of the year, because every race we learn, every race we come up with small ways to close the gap.

"On the other side, I equally know that we will not be the benchmark before the end of the season, that it will require some significant design and hardware changes, and that this is something that we will see only next year."
keyPointsZh: 维斯塔潘和哈贾尔分别从第二位和第三位起步，但起步表现不佳。
车队领队洛朗·梅基斯在冲线后通过无线电承认车队有"几件事需要整理"。
keyPointsEn: Verstappen and Hadjar started second and third but made poor getaways.
Team principal Laurent Mekies admitted over the radio right after the chequered flag that the team had "a few things to tidy up".

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
keyPointsZh: 倍耐力在击败普利司通的竞争性报价后赢得2025至2027年的F1轮胎供应合同，今年6月国际汽联行使选择权将合同延长一个赛季。
国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
